method: Two separately articulated source foliage ears; intact head rotates at the neck; body compresses above planted feet and front-paw mesh tucks during a hop. Unlettered, unarmed source reflected to face left. No newly invented hidden body parts.

actions.idle: Small independent ear twitches; the clipped shrub body stays almost still.
actions.attack: Plant feet and crouch, spring into a small leftward hop with tucked paw and lagging ears, land softly and recover.
actions.hurt: Quick rightward recoil, head flinch, asymmetric ear response and recovery.
actions.defeat: Head bows and both long foliage ears wilt forward while the body settles into a low inactive garden ornament.

orientation.method: Whole unlettered shrub is reflected so nose/eyes face left. Hop goes left, hurt recoils right, recovery and bowed endpoint retain the left profile. No held prop or text is reversed.

review_limits: All decoded packing/timing checks passed and chronological poses inspected. Full-speed intended-size visual approval and game integration remain unverified.
